method: Whole-file global CTC forced alignment of canonical 83 verses, dual acoustic-reference agreement, unforced greedy text audit and waveform RMS onset corroboration.

review.scoreExplanation: Worst 30-frame rolling mean log posterior along the forced path; a review metric, not a confidence percentage.
knownIssues: The restricted default sliding CTC window produced an incorrect early tail in a discarded run. Final data uses the whole-file trellis.
Timestamp grid resolution is 20 ms; this is not a guarantee of absolute phonetic boundary accuracy.
Verse 3 has a higher local noise floor; two standard RMS thresholds plus an additional threshold agree at 17.20 s.
The cue remains active through interverse silence until the next measured onset; the final cue includes trailing silence.
